info.name: YourImageShare API
info.description:
Free API to upload, list, and delete images and videos on YourImageShare.

Docs: https://yourimageshare.com/about/api

Authentication: every request needs your account's API key, found on the API tab of https://yourimageshare.com/my-account. This collection sends it as an `X-API-Key` header (collection-level auth). It can alternatively be passed as a `?key=` query parameter instead - the API checks the query parameter first, then the header.

Before running: set the `api_key` collection variable to your real key. The Upload request auto-saves the returned upload id into `upload_id` so List/Delete can be run right after it with no manual copy-paste.

exec: pm.test('Response has a direct URL', function () {

formdata.description: The image or video file to upload. Field name must be exactly "uploads".
Optional. Auto-delete after this many seconds (60 to 2592000, i.e. 1 minute to 30 days). Enable this field and set a value to test expiring uploads.

request.description:
Uploads a single image or video. On success, returns the direct URL, page URL, and an id you can use with List/Delete.

Responses:
- 200: `{ "type": "success", "data": { "id", "type", "path", "src", "direct", "expires_at" } }`
- 401: missing/invalid API key
- 403: account or IP is banned
- 422: missing file, unsupported/invalid file, file previously flagged by moderation, or an out-of-range `expires_in`
- 500: upload/server error

exec: pm.test('Response has a data array and pagination meta', function () {

request.description:
Lists the authenticated account's own uploads, newest first, 50 per page.

Responses:
- 200: `{ "type": "success", "data": [ { "id", "type", "title", "path", "src", "direct", "expires_at", "created_at" }, ... ], "meta": { "current_page", "last_page", "total" } }`
- 401: missing/invalid API key

Deletes an upload by id (owned by the authenticated account). `upload_id` is auto-filled by the Upload File request's test script, or set it manually.

Responses:
- 200: `{ "type": "success", "msg": "Deleted." }`
- 401: missing/invalid API key
- 404: not found, not owned by this account, or already deleted
